manifest.name: Mermaid
manifest.description: Cindy 内置的 Mermaid 绘图插件：把 Agent 编写的流程图、时序图、架构图等 Mermaid 源码做确定性规范化与常见语法修复，返回可直接渲染的 Mermaid Markdown。
manifest.whenToUse: 需要用 Mermaid 绘制或修改流程图、时序图、架构图、状态图、类图、甘特图、ER 图等图表，或需要整理 Mermaid 源码时找我。
manifest.author: Cindy

tools.name: prepare_mermaid
tools.description: 整理一份完整 Mermaid 源码并返回可直接放进回答的 Markdown 代码块。用户要求画 Mermaid 图、流程图、时序图、架构图、状态图、类图、甘特图或 ER 图时，先自行编写完整 Mermaid 源码，再调用本工具，并使用返回的 markdown 作为最终图表；不要自行重新抄写或改动返回源码。工具会做换行规范化和常见机械语法修复，但不会调用 Mermaid 引擎 parse/render，也不保证语义或完整语法一定有效。返回 JSON：{ markdown, source, changed, validation: "not-performed", note }。

source.description: 完整 Mermaid 源码，可带或不带最外层 ```mermaid 代码围栏；不要传自然语言说明。

en.name: Mermaid
en.description: Cindy's built-in Mermaid diagram plugin. It deterministically normalizes Mermaid source written by the Agent, fixes common mechanical syntax issues, and returns render-ready Mermaid Markdown.
en.whenToUse: Use this plugin to create or revise Mermaid flowcharts, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, state diagrams, class diagrams, Gantt charts, ER diagrams, or to clean up Mermaid source.

tools.name: prepare_mermaid
tools.description: Normalize complete Mermaid source and return a Markdown code block ready to include in the answer. When the user requests a Mermaid diagram, first write the complete Mermaid source, then call this tool and use the returned markdown as the final diagram without copying or changing its source. The tool normalizes line endings and fixes common mechanical syntax issues, but it does not run Mermaid parse/render and cannot guarantee semantic or full syntactic validity. Returns { markdown, source, changed, validation: "not-performed", note }.
